description: Read the stored Akoma Ntoso XML of an act in slices. Returns act_urn, version_date, sha256 of the stored document, total_length (characters), the offset asked, the slice and next_offset (NULL when the slice reaches the end): call again with offset = next_offset until it is NULL, and joining the slices gives the whole document. Parameters: act_urn (act URN without the article part), offset (characters to skip, default 0), length (1..100000, default 100000). Example: {"act_urn": "urn:nir:stato:legge:2000-07-27;212", "offset": 0}.
